_gram: [{#brahmaRa idaM tena proktaM vA aR wilopaH#}]

_meanings:
.²1 One of the eight forms of marriage in Hindu law, in which the bride
 decorated with ornaments is given away to the bridegroom, without requiring
 any gift or present from him (this is the best of the 8 forms); {#brAhmo#}
 {#vivAha AhUya dIyate SaktyalaMkftA#} <ls>Y. 1. 58</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 21</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 3.">27</ls>.
.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Nārada.
.²3 Quicksilver.
.²4 The duty or prescribed course of conduct of a king; {#AvfttAnAM gurukulAt#}
 {#viprARAM pUjyako Bavet . nfpARAmakzayo hyeza brAhmo Darmo viDIyate ..#}.

.²1 The part of the hand under the root of the thumb; {#aNguzWamUlasya#}
 {#tale brAhmaM tIrTaM pracakzate#} <ls>Ms. 2. 59</ls>.
.²2 Holy or sacred study.
.²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a Purāṇa.
.²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the constellation Rohiṇī.
a day and night of Brahman (a period of 2 Kalpas of mortals).
a girl to be married according to the Brāhma form.
money bestowed on the sacerdotal class.
